title: Per-step compute — exact vs surrogate
interpretation: Wall-clock per step, measured live (bench_live.json, warm): one exact CVODE step of the real 91-state sepsis model is ~526 ms, versus ~0.040 ms for a surrogate forward pass — 13,015× faster. This is where the compute goes: the stiff ODE solve.
